summary.text: KathleenMae Rogers is an independent write-in candidate for Missouri's 4th District.
A Marine Corps veteran and graduate student whose research focuses on post-traumatic stress disorder treatment and access to treatment, she has not held public office.

paragraphs.text: Rogers has said she is running as an independent write-in candidate so that residents will have someone who will represent them rather than partisan interests.
